messages:
maria: Quick iteration: people asked for clearer token breakdowns without sacrificing density. Attached a mock where token rows are hidden behind an accessible flyout instead of inline expansion. Thoughts on discoverability + keyboard flow? Screenshot: https://figma.com/...

jonah: flyout could work; ensure it's modal-in-nature for keyboard users so focus traps inside. But that adds friction vs inline expand. Maybe escape hatch: shift+click opens flyout, normal click toggles inline?

rebecca: backend note: flyout requires a single API call to /projects/:id/usage-detail; inline expansion can stream partial rows. Prefer a single route to simplify and let client decide.

sam-a11y: flyout must be accessible: role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"true\", focus trap, and close button with aria-label. For screen readers provide summary text at top. Keyboard invocation should be straightforward.

leah: CS says customers like inline because it's faster to glance. But they also appreciate a bigger flyout for long lists to avoid jumping content. Maybe both: inline for small lists, flyout for long.

oliver: product leaning: default inline, fallback to flyout when rows > 10. We'll set threshold server-side or have the client switch based on count. Also add a per-card `Download CSV` link.

maria: accessibility followups: Sam can you mock announcement strings? Also we need to document roving-tabindex behavior in the dev spec.

sam-a11y: announcement examples: \"Project tokens: details expanded\" / \"Project tokens: details closed\" and when flyout opens say \"Project tokens for <project name>, 30 entries\". I'll add exact strings in spec.

rebecca: API contract: /projects/:id/usage-summary => { totals, sparkline_url } ; /projects/:id/usage-detail?page=1 => paginated rows. Will return header X-Total-Count to help client decide flyout vs inline.

jonah: visual small tweak: make the delta pill icon include a small caret to reinforce direction; and add tooltip on hover explaining how delta is computed.

leah: copy: change card subtitle from \"Tokens\" to \"Model tokens (inference + context)\" and add tooltip.

maria: test plan: A/B with control (current layout) vs variant B (dense 3-col with inline+flyout + header CTA). Track invoice download rate, avg projects visible, and support tickets.

oliver: timeline fine. Rebecca, will you add feature flag gating?

rebecca: yes - flag `dense-usage-experiment`. Will also add prefetch param documented.

maria: ok locking this direction for prototype. Thanks team! :party_parrot:
